step1.title: Welcome to LittleFounders! 🚀

step1.title: Welcome to LittleFounders - Tutor Mode 🎓
step1.desc: This platform is designed to empower children in their financial education. Here we show you how you can supervise and guide.

step2.title: Educational Curriculum
step2.desc: Review academic progress. Lessons are designed pedagogically for different ages.

step_ai.title: Educational AI Assistant
step_ai.desc: A safe AI-powered tool that answers children's questions and suggests conversation topics for you.

step3.title: Task Assignment
step3.desc: The main tool for teaching the value of work. Assign household chores or challenges with real or virtual rewards.

step4.title: Savings Supervision
step4.desc: Monitor your children's saving goals. You can incentivize saving with extra contributions (parental interest).

step5.title: Business Simulators
step5.desc: Safe spaces where they can fail and learn. Entrepreneurship simulations without real risk.

step6.title: Parental Banking Control
step6.desc: Define spending limits, block cards, and monitor transactions in real time.

step7.title: Rewards Control
step7.desc: Configure what they can 'buy' with their points. From screen time to special outings.

step8.title: All Set 🌟
step8.desc: You have toured the key functions. Freely explore the platform to see the educational potential.
